hero.lede: Building a brand is hard - thats why we take the guesswork out of it. Ten years negotiating high-value commercial contracts, plus hands-on experience building a 2 million-follower recognisable brand — for founders who need sharper content and safer deals, without a full-time hire.

founders.name: Molly Maguire
founders.bio: By day, an RICS-chartered surveyor with ten years' experience structuring and negotiating high-value commercial contracts, and assisting corporates in strategy curation across global real estate portfolios — negotiating over £19m in lease value last year alone. Molly has a proven track record in the commercial sector which she uses to propel the strategy behind TJ the Frenchie.

founders.name: Duncan Tout
founders.bio: The face of TJ and Duncan, a pet content creator and recognisable brand built from the ground up to a combined 2 million followers across platforms. Duncan provides advice on creative strategy, production, and what actually gets an audience to watch, trust, and buy.

closingNote: Most content advisors have never negotiated a contract with real financial weight behind it. Most commercial negotiators have never built an audience or made content themselves. Between us, we've done both — which is what we bring to your content and partnership strategy.

services.title: Content Audit & Strategy
services.description: A written audit of your current approach and a 90-day plan. We work out what you should be posting, how to grow in your sector and build trust from your audience through content. We then help build out the strategy around your target audience -understanding who you're trying to reach and what they need from you to convert into a follower/customer.

services.title: Influencer & Partnership Strategy
services.description: We assess the options with a commercial lens to help you to design the most robust and efficient approach to partnerships. Whether thats large scale influencers and ambassadors, micro and nano creators, UGC or product seeding— a bespoke approach to each company.

services.title: Content Briefs & Video Concepts
services.description: Specific, shootable ideas — assistance with content briefs ready to hand to a videographer, editor, or in-house team, so strategy turns into content without another hire.
services.fee: DELIVERED PER BATCH · TURNAROUND AGREED UPFRONT

services.title: Contract Review
services.description: Considering a brand partnership? I'll review the agreement — usage rights, exclusivity, fees — and flag anything that puts you at a disadvantage before you sign.

process.title: Discovery call
process.description: 30 minutes on where you're at, whats been working and where you'd like to go.

process.title: Audit & research
process.description: Your current presence, reviewed against what's working in your space.

process.title: Written plan
process.description: A clear 90-day plan you can act on immediately - this can cover anything from influencer/partnership plans, key content pillars, assessing marketing spend and beyond.

process.title: Ongoing support and management
process.description: We then review and agree next steps with the option for us provide ongoing support and management of your social pages - showing the strategy in action, or leave you to run with the strategy solo.

contact.heading: Let's see if it's a fit.
contact.text: A short call is the best way to know if it's useful for where you're at. No obligation — send a few details and we'll reply directly.
